scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.validate:api-generated: pnpm run test:api-compatibility && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run test:generated-drift && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run check:compatibility && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run verify
scripts.validate:api-generated:clean: sh -c 'echo "[api-generated] setup: installing the locked workspace dependencies"; if ! pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; then echo "[api-generated] setup failed: frozen-lockfile install could not reproduce the workspace" >&2; exit 1; fi; pnpm run validate:api-generated'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
